summary_1line: Drona trains the Kuru princes; Arjuna proves most devoted, Ekalavya sacrifices his thumb, and rivalries among the students intensify.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ekalavya calmly cuts off his right thumb and offers it to Drona before the clay statue of the teacher in the forest.
A hunting dog runs back to the princes with its mouth sealed by seven perfectly placed arrows without a drop of blood.
At night Arjuna practices archery in darkness while Drona embraces him, hearing the twang of the bowstring.
